title: PublishTestResultsParams
description: Params of `csp/publishTestResults`. Results are batched per notification but always tagged with `run_id` so the client can group them.

partial.description: True when this is a **selective** run covering only a subset of tests (e.g. re-running failures). The client merges these into existing results rather than replacing the whole set.

Location.description: A location inside a document — a URI plus a range. Mirrors LSP `Location`.

Position.description: Zero-based line/character position, identical in shape to LSP `Position`.

character.description: Zero-based character offset within the line (UTF-16 code units, as in LSP).

Range.description: A range between two positions, end-exclusive — identical to LSP `Range`.

TestResult.description: The result of executing one test in a run.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds, if measured.

location.description: Location to surface the failure at (e.g. the failing assertion).

TestStatus.description: Outcome of running a single test.
